integrity: The proof contains explicit all-parameter moment formulas, an exact positivity certificate, and a complete angular sign analysis; symbolic checks are reproducible but are not independent scientific validation.
limitations: Nondegenerate Euclidean parallelograms only; independent area- versus arclength-uniform endpoints and fourth moments only.
No universal upper ratio for all planar convex bodies is claimed.
The most closely related convex-order source was checked at abstract level only; an exact unindexed upper comparison or an appendix example remains possible.
title: Fourth-chord moment amplification and angular phase transition for parallelograms
